Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Connecticut Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 133,816 megawatthours
B. 44,627,596 megawatthours

Source citation: Connecticut Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/connecticut/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
